_about: Training examples for the local AI. 'train' = worked examples; the closest ones that fit are shown to the model before each real email (it does not retrain the model, it shows it what a good summary looks like). 'eval' = held-out test cases for `python -m app.evaluate`, never shown to the model, so the score is honest. In a bullet, 'ACTION:' marks something the reader must do. Edit freely: add your own real emails (remove private details first). Every bullet must only use facts that are in its email. Bullets never say 'no action needed' or 'no need to reply' - the reader decides that. 'symbols' on a training example = the symbol names the answer's final SYMBOLS line gives (none = no symbol, which is common and fine). 'symbols_ok' on an eval case = the only symbols that would be acceptable (the score counts a wrong one as a miss; none at all is always safe).
